yt_title: How to find a gift idea you saved on Instagram
caption:
You saved a gift idea months ago. Where?

Instagram first: check Saved, and your Collections if you made them.

No collections? SaveSort sorts every save by topic into about 10 topics, so it's not one long pile. There's no gift topic yet.

Tip: start a Gifts collection now.

How to sort your Instagram saved reels: download your Instagram data, tick only Saved, drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing gets uploaded.

Find yours before Christmas. Sort yours free, link in bio.

Sorty's voice is AI. The saves and numbers are real.

#savedreels #instagramtips #giftideas #christmas #productivity
